sv.title: Kim Jong-Uns dotter pekas ut för brottet
sv.summary: Kim Jong-Uns dotters kläder kan utgöra sanktionsbrott. Det varnar USA för, skriver South China Morning Post.

en.title: Kim Jong-Un's daughter named over the offence
en.summary: Kim Jong-Un's daughter's clothing may constitute a sanctions violation. The US warns of this, according to the South China Morning Post.
